% pdfTeX's driver option given to the class as PDFTeX, and to changebar
% beside its color and outerbars options, which changebar still reads.
% Without the color option, \cbcolor writes a warning to the log and
% ignores its argument. The text is the same as without the driver option.
\documentclass[PDFTeX]{article}
\usepackage[pdftex,color,outerbars]{changebar}
\begin{document}
Before the bar. \cbcolor{red}\cbstart Red bar.\cbend{} After the red bar.
\end{document}
